propositions: Container tickets with no declared file_impact fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation, causing every unrelated commit to invalidate the attestation and force re-review.

Containers should inherit the union of DIRECT children's file_impact if all non-closed children declare non-empty scope; if any non-closed child lacks file_impact, the poison rule preserves the pre-change (empty) set to maintain fail-closed invalidation.

Children already pinned in the container's material_fingerprint ensure one-level self-healing: changes to a child's file_impact or addition/removal of children invalidate the container's attestation via pin/material drift.

The orchestrator's assembled context already provides ctx.children with status and file_impact; threading this through sign_plan_review and dependency_hashes avoids new store reads and respects the pinned ticket snapshot in attested mode.

P9 (plan-floor) must extend to surface an advisory (non-blocking) on containers with poisoned inheritance, naming which children have empty file_impact, while auto-passing containers with effective inheritance and leaving leaf behavior unchanged.
